newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Jasa Marga may float 25-35 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Jasa Marga may float 25-35 pct stake.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned giant toll-road operator PT Jasa Marga said on Monday it was likely to offer a 25-to-35 percent stake to the public during an initial public offering expected later this year.

"The percentage (to be offered to the public) is likely to be between 25 to 35 percent. There is no final decision yet," Maryadi Dharmokumoro told reporters after briefing analysts at a meeting organised by PT ING Barings Securities Indonesia.
Darmokumoro declined to give other details, saying the listing on the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges was likely to be held after the country's general election in May.

Jasa Marga posted a net profit of 266.17 billion rupiah on total revenues of 519.3 billion rupiah in 1995, compared with a a net profit 190.04 billion rupiah on total revenues of 449.83 billion rupiah in 1994.
